newsitem.title: USA: Trimedyne to market Spinal Endoscope.
newsitem.headline: Trimedyne to market Spinal Endoscope.

text.p: Trimedyne Inc said it will begin worldwide marketing of its OmniView Spinal Endoscope for the outpatient treatment of herniated discs.
It said about 400,000 Americans undergo surgery for herniated discs each year.

Its Endoscope is 1/6 of an inch in diameter, which it said provides a minimally invasive oupatient alternative to other surgical procedures. The Endoscope contains a channel through which with Trimedyne's laser needle is inserted, transmitting laser energy to the protruding disc material.
